picks.file: Césarée et le mont Argée - Texier Charles Félix Marie - 1882.jpg
picks.what: View from the citadel walls toward Mount Erciyes, engraving in Charles Texier’s Asie Mineure
picks.why: true general view: citadel tower, the flat-roofed town and Mount Erciyes behind

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (a tile, a miniature of Sinan, a book binding); P5: only a map, a crowd and an aircraft hangar; P6: only a 360° panorama of a rebuilt square and a museum courtyard, both weak
notes: #4: Commons gives 1882, the date of the reprint the scan comes from; Texier’s Asie Mineure (L’Univers pittoresque, Firmin-Didot) first appeared in 1862 with these plates, drawn by Texier on his 1830s travels. If the reviewer prefers the documented date, use 1882 (same period).
